cs.t: > People spend hundreds of dollars and many hours sharpening kitchen knives I am ashamed to admit it, but I have been happily using this 5,99 EUR IKEA knife sharpener for nearly 10 years know:  https://www.ikea.com/de/en/p/aspekt-knife-sharpener-black-57...  I use it 1-2 times a month for 30 seconds on the 2 knives I use in the kitchen. They pass the paper test. Previously, I used the bottom of a coffee mug. That being said, thinks like [0] do exist and people seem to buy them. [0]  https://www.horl.com/us/en/sharpeners/
